description: INVERSE planner: given model + context + traffic volume + optional TTFT/cost/throughput ceilings, search every GPU × topology (1/2/4/8 GPUs) and return feasible configurations ranked by cost, throughput, or value. Use when the user knows their SLOs but not the hardware.

batchSize.description: Concurrent requests the config must hold simultaneously.

contextTokens.description: Context length the workload must serve.

maxCostPerMillion.description: Hard ceiling on $/M output tokens. Configs above it are excluded.

maxTtftMs.description: Hard ceiling on time-to-first-token in ms. Configs above it are excluded.

minTokensPerSecond.description: Minimum aggregate tok/s the config must deliver at the given batchSize.

model.description: Canonical tokcalc model ID (e.g. 'llama3-8b'). Call list_models first if unknown.

requestsPerDay.description: Expected daily request volume (drives the monthly cost estimate).

name: find_config_for_slo
